about: Mono is a town in Dufferin County, Ontario, a largely rural municipality of farms, estate lots, and river valleys north of Orangeville—not a dense urban centre. Hockley Valley, Mono Cliffs, and the headwaters country of the Nottawasaga and Credit systems define the landscape. About 9,000 people live in Mono.
seoSummary: Rural Dufferin County town of farms and valleys—Hockley Valley and Mono Cliffs, not a city streetscape.
